$comment: Shared cases for the strict hand-back check (plan deviation d3). Generated by scripts/strict_vectors.ts, which runs the extension's own runStrict with a fake decider returning each case's stored answers; held byte-identical in evidence-cli. The shape is described in docs/notes/strict-vectors.md. Do not edit by hand: change the inputs in the script and regenerate.
